license.title: License
license.description: Activate Projelli with a license key purchased at <pricingLink>projelli.com</pricingLink>.
license.deactivate-confirm: Deactivate this license? You will lose access to paid features until you re-activate.
license.trial-expired-detail: Your {{days}}-day free trial ended on <endDateBold>{{endDate}}</endDateBold>. AI chat and workflows are paused. Your existing files are still here, fully readable. Activate a license to keep building.
license.trial-active-detail: You're on the free trial. Every Projelli feature is unlocked for {{days}} days from first launch, bring your own AI keys, run workflows, edit files, the works. When the trial ends, AI chat and workflows pause until you activate a license; your files stay accessible.

unlocks.ai-chat: AI chat with your own keys (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini)
unlocks.workspaces: Unlimited workspaces, files, and version history
unlocks.lifetime-extras: Multi-model comparison & commercial use on Lifetime

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Projelli is local-first. Your files, your AI prompts, and your API keys never leave your machine. The two opt-ins below are the only data Projelli ever collects, and both default to off.

telemetry.title: Anonymous usage stats
telemetry.description: Help improve Projelli by sending lifecycle events: app launches, trial start, trial end, license activated, license deactivated. No content, no files, no AI prompts, no email.
telemetry.field-install-id: <c>install_id</c>: a random UUID generated on this machine (visible below). Not tied to your email or license.
telemetry.field-app-version: <c>app_version</c>, <c>platform</c>: which build of Projelli, and macOS / Windows / Linux.
telemetry.endpoint-note: Endpoint: <c>projelli.com/api/forms/projelli/app-event</c>. JSONL stored on Jameson's server. Used only for funnel metrics and roadmap decisions.

email.title: Email updates
email.intro: If you opted into email updates at first launch (or via the website), you'll get launch announcements and discount codes. No drip campaigns, no weekly newsletters.
email.unsub: To remove yourself from the list, reply <c>UNSUB</c> to any email from Jameson, they all forward straight to him.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.description: Expose your Projelli workspace to any MCP-compatible AI client. Install once, then ask Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any other client about your notes, chats, and memory facts without copy-pasting.

status.ready: Ready to install in Claude Desktop
status.unavailable: Bundle not available. Run <cmd>node scripts/build-mcpb.mjs</cmd> first, or install via a released build.

install.heading: How to install:
install.step-download: Click Download .mcpb above to copy the bundle path to your clipboard.
install.step-config: Open Settings, Developer, Edit Config, or drag the .mcpb file into the Claude Desktop window.
install.step-pick-folder: When prompted for a workspace folder, pick the same folder you opened in Projelli.
install.after-install: After install, ask Claude "search my Projelli workspace for X" or "read notes/plan.md" and watch it work.

mcp-approval.title: Claude Desktop wants to write to your workspace
mcp-approval.description: Review the change below. Nothing happens until you approve.
mcp-approval.more-queued_one: 1 more write queued after this one.
mcp-approval.more-queued_other: {{count}} more writes queued after this one.

ollama.title: Ollama (local models)
ollama.description: Run AI models directly on your machine: free, offline, private. Projelli talks to a locally running Ollama daemon on <c>127.0.0.1:11434</c>.

status.not-running: Ollama not running. Install it to run AI models locally, free.

ollama.no-models-hint: Ollama is running but no models are installed. Pull one with <c>ollama pull llama3.2:3b</c> and click Check again.

why.heading: Why Ollama?
why.zero-cost: Zero cost. Inference runs on your GPU / CPU.
why.zero-network: Zero network. Works on a plane, offline, in a tunnel.
why.zero-data: Zero data sharing. Your prompts never leave the machine.

ollama.recommended-model: Recommended first model: <c>llama3.2:3b</c> (about 2 GB, runs on almost any laptop).

memory-facts.title: Memory Facts
memory-facts.description: Durable facts about you that the AI always knows. Stored locally at <c>.projelli/memory.json</c> in your workspace.
memory-facts.empty: No facts saved yet. Proposed facts from chat conversations will show up here after you accept them.

template-models.title: Per-template model assignment
template-models.description: Pin a provider and model for each template. Leave blank to use the template's built-in default (or your global default).

mobile-page.title: Mobile
mobile-page.description: Read your Projelli workspace on your phone today. Point Projelli at a synced folder on your computer (iCloud, Dropbox, Syncthing, or Google Drive) and the same files show up on your phone in the matching app. The dedicated Projelli mobile reader is in beta and lands in the v2.0 cycle.
mobile-page.heads-up-text: Treat your phone as read-only while using the cloud sync workaround. Editing the same file on two devices in quick succession can produce a conflict copy.

api-keys.title: API Keys
api-keys.description: Configure API keys for AI model providers. Keys are stored securely and never logged.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Manage installed plugins and the settings each plugin contributes.
plugins.empty: No plugins installed yet. Install one from a plugin tarball to see it here.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Hands-free capture via a bundled offline speech-recognition model. Audio never leaves your machine. Press-to-talk inserts into the focused text field; voice-to-note saves a new Markdown file into <c>Inbox/</c>.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Power-user settings, including per-feature kill switches. Streams populate as features land.
